chapter_title: A JOURNEY THROUGH STATES OF WATER

items.title: Ice and Water are Different Substances
items.explanation: Thirav is correct. Ice feels hard because it is frozen water, whereas liquid water cannot be held in the same way. When ice melts, it turns into liquid water, which flows and splashes. This shows that while they are made of the same substance (water), their physical states and behaviors differ.

items.title: Water Disappears Through Seepage
items.explanation: When water is left on a surface like a steel plate, it can seep through microscopic pores into the soil or underlying layers. This explains why puddles disappear after some time and why water dries up from surfaces.

items.title: Condensation Forms Water Droplets
items.explanation: When warm air touches a cold surface like a glass tumbler, the water vapor in the air condenses into liquid droplets on the cooler surface. This is another way water appears to disappear from the air and form visible drops.
